limitations: The verifier is an independent model pass, not human ground truth.
The local stratum has 300 distinct texts; sparse cells depend on smoothing.
Bootstrap intervals represent verifier-sample uncertainty under this correction model, not total model uncertainty.
Issue corrections cannot recover false-negative complaints into a specific issue because they were never grouped.
These corrected estimates are sensitivity outputs and are not claims.csv evidence.

method.assumption: Within each word bucket, intent and topic correction factors are applied independently. Issue estimates can remove likely false positives or topic misassignments but cannot allocate predicted non-complaints into a latent issue.
method.smoothing: Laplace alpha=1.0 on P(verifier label | saved prediction, word bucket)
method.use: sensitivity analysis only; not exported as memo claims
